page.layout: One column of text, full width, with no marginal notes. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Heading "EXPLICATIO." centred, then running text, then the catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.head: EXPLICATIO.
main_text.p: Nomine veteris Testamenti intelligimus volumen librorum sanctorum ante Chri-stum scriptum,& qui extant.
Noui,volumen librorum, qui post Christum ab Apostolis conscripti sunt. 2. ad Co-rinth.3.
main_text.head: TERTIA PARTITIO.
PROPOSITIO VII.

p.i: Omnes Canonici veteris Testamenti in tres classes secantur, Legem: Prophetas: ἁγιο-γραφῆς[?].

main_text.p: In hac propositione explicatum fuit, qui sint in unaquaque classe.
Noui Testamenti libri etiam in tres clas-ses distinguuntur: in Historias: Epistolas: A-pocalypsin.
main_text.head: QVARTA PARTITIO.
PROPOSITIO VIII.

p.i: Utrumq; Testamentum, in Legem & Evangelium distribuitur.

main_text.p: Ita conclusum est, quid sibi voluerit Apostolus illa sententia: Omnis Scriptura θεόπνευ-στος (ἐστι:[?]) & quot habeat partes.
Nunc methodus ipsa postulat, ut videa-mus, quænam sint illa media, quibus adduci

page.notes: Long s rendered as s throughout. Greek at the end of the first italic thesis (ἁγιο-γραφῆς) is uncertain; the scan shows a worn word after the hyphen. The Greek in the Proposition VIII line is uncertain: the parenthetical after θεόπνευστος reads like (ἐστι:) but is not clear. A stray comma-like mark stands at the left of "cæ 24" and is not transcribed. Faint show-through text from the reverse side is present and not transcribed. The catchword "homi-" is at the lower right, after the last full line.
